_meta.title: TRIZ 39 Engineering Parameters
_meta.note: Closed classical Altshuller matrix vocabulary: ids 1–39. English labels admit translation variants. Clarifications and distinction links are repository-authored mapping guidance, not formal quantity definitions or automatic domain mappings. Domain extensions belong in knowledge packs.

verification_sources.title: Prakash R. Apte, Introduction to TRIZ, list of 39 features
verification_sources.scope: Numbering and classical English label cross-check

verification_sources.title: JCGM VIM 3, measurement accuracy
verification_sources.scope: Modern metrology distinction used in clarification for parameter 28

verification_sources.title: JCGM VIM 3, measurement precision
verification_sources.scope: Repeated-measurement precision distinguished from the historical manufacturing label

audit.conclusion: All 39 classical categories are present. Moving/stationary pairs are intentional matrix distinctions. Force is the preferred label at id 10; the former Force / Intensity label remains an alias. Broader modern or domain-specific metrics do not extend this matrix implicitly.

parameters.name: Weight of moving object
parameters.clarification: Select the moving object in the modeled operation and state whether the requirement measures gravitational load or uses mass as a proxy. The historical label does not establish an SI type.

parameters.name: Weight of stationary object
parameters.clarification: Select the stationary object in the modeled operation and state whether the requirement measures gravitational load or uses mass as a proxy. The historical label does not establish an SI type.

parameters.name: Length of moving object
parameters.clarification: Name the linear dimension of the moving object being changed; specify the operating configuration and reference direction.

parameters.name: Length of stationary object
parameters.clarification: Name the linear dimension of the stationary object being changed; specify the operating configuration and reference direction.

parameters.name: Area of moving object
parameters.clarification: Specify the relevant surface or cross-sectional area of the moving object; do not substitute length, occupied volume or contour without justification.

parameters.name: Area of stationary object
parameters.clarification: Specify the relevant surface or cross-sectional area of the stationary object; do not substitute length, occupied volume or contour without justification.

parameters.name: Volume of moving object
parameters.clarification: Specify the occupied or enclosed volume of the moving object and its operating configuration; distinguish volume from material amount.

parameters.name: Volume of stationary object
parameters.clarification: Specify the occupied or enclosed volume of the stationary object and its operating configuration; distinguish volume from material amount.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.clarification: Specify the motion or process rate being changed; a faster local action does not by itself establish higher useful output per unit time.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.clarification: Specify the applied interaction or load. The historical alternate word intensity is not an automatic mapping from every signal intensity to force, and does not establish an SI type.

parameters.name: Stress or pressure
parameters.clarification: Specify load per area and the loading mode; distinguish applied stress or pressure from the material strength available to withstand it.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.clarification: Specify the contour or geometric configuration being changed; shape can change without changing area or volume.

parameters.name: Stability of the object's composition
parameters.clarification: Specify what must retain its composition or internal organization under the relevant conditions. Do not map every use of the word stable to this category automatically.

parameters.name: Strength
parameters.clarification: Specify resistance to the relevant mechanical failure or deformation mode; distinguish this capability from the force or stress applied.

parameters.name: Duration of action of moving object
aliases: Duration of action by a moving object
parameters.clarification: Specify how long the moving object can perform the required action. Distinguish available operating duration, failure risk and time wasted in performing a task.

parameters.name: Duration of action of stationary object
aliases: Duration of action by a stationary object
parameters.clarification: Specify how long the stationary object can perform the required action. Distinguish available operating duration, failure risk and time wasted in performing a task.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.clarification: Specify where and when temperature is evaluated; energy content, energy-transfer rate and material temperature are different requirements.

parameters.name: Illumination intensity
parameters.clarification: Specify the optical measure and observation geometry. This historical umbrella label does not select luminous intensity, illuminance, luminance or a universal SI dimension automatically.

parameters.name: Use of energy by moving object
parameters.clarification: Specify the energy consumed by the moving object over a defined operating interval or task. Energy use, energy per unit time and unwanted energy loss are distinct.

parameters.name: Use of energy by stationary object
parameters.clarification: Specify the energy consumed by the stationary object over a defined operating interval or task. Energy use, energy per unit time and unwanted energy loss are distinct.

parameters.name: Power
parameters.clarification: Specify the energy-transfer or work rate and the operating condition; a total energy requirement alone is not a power requirement.

parameters.name: Loss of energy
parameters.clarification: Specify the energy that fails to serve the intended function within the chosen boundary. Heat is not inherently a loss when heating is the useful function.

parameters.name: Loss of substance
parameters.clarification: Specify unwanted loss of material across a defined boundary or through a process; distinguish loss from the amount intentionally present or consumed for useful work.

parameters.name: Loss of information
parameters.clarification: Specify what information is lost, corrupted or unavailable at the required point; distinguish information loss from delay and measurement accuracy.

parameters.name: Loss of time
parameters.clarification: Specify unwanted delay or time consumption over a defined task and interval; distinguish wasted time from usable operating duration and useful output rate.

parameters.name: Quantity of substance / matter
parameters.clarification: Specify the material or items counted and the measurement basis. This broad historical category does not automatically mean the SI amount of substance measured in moles.

parameters.name: Reliability
parameters.clarification: Specify successful operation, required conditions and the relevant interval; operating duration, availability and reliability are not interchangeable without a stated model.

parameters.name: Measurement accuracy
parameters.clarification: Specify the measurand and reference, with an error or uncertainty criterion. Measurement accuracy is distinct from repeatability alone and from how closely manufactured parts meet specification.

parameters.name: Manufacturing precision
parameters.clarification: Specify conformity of manufactured output to the required dimensions or other specifications. Historical precision wording does not mean sensor accuracy or repeated-reading agreement alone.

parameters.name: External harm affecting object
parameters.clarification: Identify the harmful influence acting on the object from its surroundings, keeping the system boundary explicit.

parameters.name: Object-generated harmful factors
parameters.clarification: Identify the harmful influence produced by the object and what receives it, keeping the system boundary explicit.

parameters.name: Ease of manufacture
parameters.clarification: Specify the difficulty or effort of making the object; a simple structure does not automatically guarantee easy manufacture or accurate output.

parameters.name: Ease of operation
parameters.clarification: Specify the effort and difficulty of normal operation; distinguish operation from repair and from the degree of automation.

parameters.name: Ease of repair
parameters.clarification: Specify the effort or difficulty of restoring required function after a fault or degradation; distinguish repair from normal operation.

parameters.name: Adaptability or versatility
parameters.clarification: Specify the changed tasks or operating conditions that the object must accommodate; adaptability alone does not establish reliable performance under those conditions.

parameters.name: Device complexity
parameters.clarification: Specify structural or organizational complexity within the system; difficulty of observing, testing or measuring it is a separate requirement.

parameters.name: Difficulty of detecting and measuring
parameters.clarification: Specify the effort or difficulty of detecting, observing, inspecting or measuring the required property; distinguish this burden from the accuracy of the resulting measurement.

parameters.name: Extent of automation
parameters.clarification: Specify which operations are automatic and under which conditions; automation does not by itself guarantee easy operation, adaptability or reliability.

parameters.name: Productivity
parameters.clarification: Specify useful output per declared unit of time and its acceptance criteria; local speed or reduced delay alone does not establish end-to-end productivity.
